key.recruits_rts_camera.show_planned_ord: Hold to Show All Planned Orders
recruits_rts_camera.stat.damage.descript: Determines the damage dealt by the soldier's currently equipped weapon, including melee and ranged weapons.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.melee_skill.des: Determines how effectively a soldier lands melee attacks. Higher skill increases the chance of successfully hitting an opponent.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.melee_defence.d: Determines how effectively a soldier avoids, blocks or parries incoming melee attacks.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.charge_bonus.de: Determines the additional damage and morale shock inflicted when charging into an enemy.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.speed.descripti: Current movement capability after mount, armor, inventory load, fatigue, formation and other active speed modifiers.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.morale.descript: Determines a soldier's willingness to continue fighting. Ranges from 0 to 100, potentially reaching 110 with exceptional leadership; at 0, the soldier routes.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.fatigue.descrip: Represents physical exhaustion accumulated through movement and combat. Higher fatigue reduces combat effectiveness.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.accuracy.descri: Determines how precisely a soldier fires ranged weapons at their intended target.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.ammunition.desc: Determines how much ammunition a soldier carries and has available for ranged combat.
recruits_rts_camera.stat.rate_of_fire.de: Determines how quickly a soldier can fire ranged weapons, affected by weapon type and potentially fatigue.
